allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed hostnames or IP addresses that may access the server.

items.description: A single allowed hostname or IP address.

cache_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory where floppy disk images are cached.

host.description: The network interface address to bind the HTTP server to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

io_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a disk operation before timing out.

max_concurrent_ops.description: Maximum number of simultaneous disk I/O operations allowed.

mount_options.description: Optional key-value pairs to configure floppy disk mount options (e.g., `ro: true`, `cache: false`).

port.description: The TCP port on which the floppyd HTTP server listens.

rate_limit_max_rpm.description: Maximum number of requests per minute per IP when rate limiting is enabled.

rate_limiting_enabled.description: Enable request rate limiting per client IP address.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format).

tls_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format).

verbose.description: Enable detailed logging for debugging and diagnostics.
